**A inscrição NÃO será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir.**

**English:**
The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the register tab.

**The registration will NOT be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be approved and you will not be allowed to compete.**

Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 50 payers.

items.information:
**[FR]**
Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule).
En raison de la situation sanitaire, les conditions d'accès à la compétition peuvent changer au gré des annonces gouvernementales. L'équipe d'organisation vous informera des restrictions en vigueur à chaque changement.

Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet [Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Pasde3x3aGatineau2024#36319-sante-securite-health-safety).

Si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée.

### Avis de droit à l'image
Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

---

**[EN]**
Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule).
Due to the sanitary situation, the conditions for accessing the competition venue can vary due to the government's announcements. The organization team will inform everybody of the restrictions as they change. 

Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Pasde3x3aGatineau2024#36319-sante-securite-health-safety).

If you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes.

### Notice of Filming and Photography
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:
Oskemen Open 2023 - это открытый чемпионат в городе Усть-Каменогорск.
Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3500 тенге.
Данные соревнования организованы командой QBERS и Восточно-Казахстанским университетом имени С. Аманжолова.

**Русский**
Oskemen Open 2023 - это открытый чемпионат в городе Усть-Каменогорск.
Базовый регистрационный взнос за одну дисциплину составляет 1000 тенге. 
Регистрационный взнос 3500 тенге за дополнительные дисциплины
Данные соревнования организованы командой QBERS и Восточно-Казахстанским университетом имени С. Аманжолова.

**Қазақша**

Oskemen Open 2023 - бұл Өскемен қаласындағы ашық чемпионат.
Бір пәнге тіркеудің базалық ақысы 1000 теңге. 
Қосымша пәндердің тіркелу ақысы 3500 теңге.
Бұл жарысты QBERS командасы мен С.Аманжолов атындағы Шығыс Қазақстан университеті ұйымдастырып отыр.

**English**

Oskemen Open 2023  is a competition in the city of Oskemen.
The base registration fee for a single event is 1000 tenge.
The registration fee is 3500 tenge for additional events.

These competitions are organized by the QBERS team and Amanzholov University.

items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło aż 60 turnieje w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: DeNxNver 2024
items.information:
Welcome back for a second reindition of DeNxNver! This is a winter competition put on by Colorado Cubers.

All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering
 
**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can modify their registration through the Register tab.

Competitors can also change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund.

The deadline to change/cancel your registration is January 12th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time.

**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until January 12th at 5:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.
